title: [2.8.2.2-Dev] Insulin boluses and carbohydrates not syncing with xDrip +
symptom: When adding a treatment from the calculator, the data is synced correctly in Nightscout, but it is not synced with xDrip +. No carbohydrate or bolus treatment is displayed in xDrip +. SMBs are also not displayed.
cause: The thread indicates that there was never a direct AAPS to xDrip broadcast. Up to version 2.8.2, NSClient did broadcast data coming from NS, but with the new NSClient this functionality was removed.
evidence_quote: sorry i was wrong. there was never direct AAPS -> xDrip broadcast. up to version 2.8.2 NSClient did broadcast data comming from NS. With new NSClient this functionality was removed
